initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: Hello! I am a PARROT! (Press (V) to continue)

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: did you see those pesky balloons out there?

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: If you haven't try going in any direction away from here and you'll find some.

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: I tried popping one of those balloons with my razor sharp beak...

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: ...and there were COINS™ inside of it!

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: Yeah its super cool. I'll tell you what.

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: ...I will give you something that will CHANGE YOUR LIFE.

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: And I know that sounds like a lot, but try getting a combo, it will make it a lot easier!

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: Oh and quick tip before you go...

initial_dialogue.name: Parrot
initial_dialogue.text: If you ever stray to far from here, press (R) to come back.

completed_dialogue.name: Parrot
completed_dialogue.text: heh seems like you got the coins™!

completed_dialogue.name: Parrot
completed_dialogue.text: Well I am a parrot of his word...

completed_dialogue.name: Parrot
completed_dialogue.text: When you go into a combo, it's really hard to keep it right?

completed_dialogue.name: You
completed_dialogue.text: Oh yeah that made me really angry

completed_dialogue.text: The COMBO Medallion will make it easier to combo than ever before!
